SELECT s.survey_no AS surveyNo , s.title AS title , s.use_yn AS useYn , DATE_FORMAT(s.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDate , DATE_FORMAT(s.end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS endDate , CASE WHEN s.start_date > NOW() THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS canEdit , CASE WHEN CURDATE() BETWEEN s.start_date AND s.end_date THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS resAvail , u.user_name AS regUserName , DATE_FORMAT(s.reg_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS regDate FROM survey s JOIN users u ON u.user_no = s.reg_user WHERE s.del_yn = 'N'
ORDER BY s.survey_no DESC LIMIT #{firstIndex}, #{recordCountPerPage}

SELECT survey_no AS surveyNo , title AS title , content AS content , DATE_FORMAT(start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDate , DATE_FORMAT(end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS endDate , use_yn AS useYn FROM survey WHERE survey_no = #{surveyNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE question SET content = #{content} , type = #{type} , sort_ord = #{sortOrd} , mod_user = #{regUser} , mod_date = NOW() WHERE board_no = #{boardNo}
UPDATE q_option SET content = #{content} , sort_ord = #{sortOrd} WHERE option_no = #{optionNo}
UPDATE q_option SET use_yn = 'N' WHERE option_no = #{optionNo}
UPDATE question SET use_yn = 'N' WHERE board_no = #{boardNo}
UPDATE survey SET use_yn = 'N' WHERE survey_no = #{surveyNo}
UPDATE q_option SET use_yn = 'N' WHERE q_no = #{boardNo}
mapper.select: SELECT q.board_no AS boardNo , q.content AS content , q.type AS type , q.sort_ord AS sortOrd , fm.file_no AS imageFileNo FROM question q LEFT JOIN file_master fm ON fm.board_no = q.board_no AND fm.use_yn = 'Y' WHERE q.survey_no = #{surveyNo} AND q.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY q.sort_ord ASC
SELECT file_no AS fileNo , file_path AS filePath , file_name AS fileName , file_ext AS fileExt FROM file_master WHERE file_no = #{fileNo}

SELECT o.q_no AS qNo , o.option_no AS optionNo , o.content AS content , o.sort_ord AS sortOrd FROM q_option o JOIN question q ON q.board_no = o.q_no WHERE q.survey_no = #{surveyNo} AND o.use_yn = 'Y' AND q.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY o.q_no, o.sort_ord ASC

SELECT c.code_no AS codeNo , c.code_name AS codeName FROM code c JOIN code_group_mid cgm ON cgm.code_key = c.code_key JOIN code_group cg ON cg.group_no = cgm.group_no WHERE cg.group_code = 'Q_TYPE' ORDER BY c.sort_ord ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM survey WHERE use_yn = 'Y'
AND title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')

SELECT q.board_no AS boardNo , qo.option_no AS optionNo , qo.content AS optionContent , COUNT(rd.res_detail_no) AS cnt FROM question q JOIN q_option qo ON qo.q_no = q.board_no LEFT JOIN response_detail rd ON rd.option_no = qo.option_no WHERE q.survey_no = #{surveyNo} GROUP BY q.board_no, qo.option_no, qo.content ORDER BY q.sort_ord ASC, qo.sort_ord ASC

SELECT rd.q_no AS boardNo , rd.answer_content AS answerContent FROM response_detail rd JOIN question q ON q.board_no = rd.q_no WHERE q.survey_no = #{surveyNo} AND rd.answer_content IS NOT NULL AND rd.answer_content != '' ORDER BY rd.q_no, rd.res_detail_no

SELECT q.board_no AS boardNo , COUNT(rd.res_detail_no) AS answerCount FROM question q LEFT JOIN response_detail rd ON rd.q_no = q.board_no AND rd.answer_content IS NOT NULL AND rd.answer_content != '' WHERE q.survey_no = #{surveyNo} AND q.type IN ('text', 'textarea') AND q.use_yn = 'Y' GROUP BY q.board_no
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM response WHERE survey_no = #{surveyNo}
